candidates.title: Web-based report writer
candidates.statement: The system shall provide a web-based report writer interface that allows staff to create custom reports.
candidates.source_quote: Evergreen includes a report writer that allows staff to create custom reports using a web-based interface.

candidates.title: Drag-and-drop field selection
candidates.statement: The system shall allow report authors to select report fields via drag-and-drop field selection.
candidates.source_quote: - Drag-and-drop field selection

candidates.title: Basic filtering and sorting
candidates.statement: The system shall support basic filtering and sorting for report definitions and results.
candidates.source_quote: - Basic filtering and sorting

candidates.title: Multiple output formats
candidates.statement: The system shall provide multiple output formats for reports, including CSV, HTML, and Excel.
candidates.source_quote: - Multiple output formats (CSV, HTML, sometimes Excel)
candidates.priority_signals: Conclusion: 'Provide multiple output formats and scheduling options'

candidates.title: Save and reuse report definitions
candidates.statement: The system shall allow users to save and reuse report definitions and templates.
candidates.source_quote: - Ability to save and reuse report definitions

candidates.title: Complex query support
candidates.statement: The system shall support construction of complex queries in the report writer.
candidates.source_quote: Limitations: - Complex queries are difficult to construct

candidates.title: Boolean operators in filters
candidates.statement: The system shall support Boolean operators (AND/OR and grouping) in report filters.
candidates.source_quote: - No Boolean operators (AND/OR) beyond simple filters

candidates.title: Full database field availability
candidates.statement: The system shall expose a comprehensive set of database fields for reporting rather than a limited subset.
candidates.source_quote: - Limited field selection (not all database fields are available)

candidates.title: Regular expression support
candidates.statement: The system shall support regular expression matching in report filters.
candidates.source_quote: - No regular expression support

candidates.title: Report queue visibility
candidates.statement: The system shall provide visibility into the report/query queue showing queue position and status for submitted reports.
candidates.source_quote: - No query queue visibility
candidates.priority_signals: Conclusion: 'Add report queue visibility and status indicators'

candidates.title: Cancel running report
candidates.statement: The system shall allow a user to cancel a running report job.
candidates.source_quote: - No ability to cancel a running report

candidates.title: Report prioritization
candidates.statement: The system shall allow prioritization of report jobs so certain report types can be prioritized in processing.
candidates.source_quote: - No ability to prioritize certain types of reports

candidates.title: Background processing for long reports
candidates.statement: The system shall provide background processing for long-running reports separate from interactive sessions.
candidates.source_quote: - No background processing for long-running reports

candidates.title: Report scheduling frequencies
candidates.statement: The system shall support scheduling reports to run Run ASAP, Hourly, Daily, Weekly, Monthly, and Yearly.
candidates.source_quote: - No ability to select Run ASAP, Hourly, Daily, Weekly, Monthly, Yearly

candidates.title: Hourly scheduling
candidates.statement: The system shall support scheduling reports to run on an hourly interval.
candidates.source_quote: - No hourly scheduling

candidates.title: Batch run multiple reports
candidates.statement: The system shall allow selecting and running multiple saved reports together in a single operation.
candidates.source_quote: - No ability to check multiple reports to run at the same time

candidates.title: Email delivery of reports
candidates.statement: The system shall support automatic email delivery of report outputs to one or more recipients.
candidates.source_quote: - No email delivery (reports can only be downloaded from the web interface)

candidates.title: Address book for deliveries
candidates.statement: The system shall provide an address book for storing and selecting report delivery recipients.
candidates.source_quote: - No address book for report delivery

candidates.title: Upload text files for filters
candidates.statement: The system shall allow uploading text files (e.g., barcodes, TCNs) to be used as filter criteria for reports.
candidates.source_quote: - No ability to upload text files for filtering (barcodes, TCNs)

candidates.title: Display selection criteria
candidates.statement: The system shall display the selection criteria used to generate a report alongside the report results.
candidates.source_quote: - No selection criteria display in report results

candidates.title: Edit canned report display
candidates.statement: The system shall allow editing display options for canned reports (columns, order, formats).
candidates.source_quote: - No ability to edit canned report display options

candidates.title: Quick access with pop-up descriptions
candidates.statement: The system shall provide a quick-access interface that shows pop-up descriptions for reports and options.
candidates.source_quote: - No quick access interface with pop-up descriptions

candidates.title: Hover tooltips for report titles
candidates.statement: The system shall show hover tooltips for report titles to provide brief descriptions.
candidates.source_quote: - No hover tooltips for report titles

candidates.title: Pivot table output
candidates.statement: The system shall support pivot table style output for reports (cross-tabulation and aggregation).
candidates.source_quote: - No pivot table output

candidates.title: Separate reporting database/replica
candidates.statement: The system shall provide a separate reporting database or read-replica so reporting does not run on the production transactional database.
candidates.source_quote: - No separate reporting database/replica (reports run on production database)

candidates.title: Report template management
candidates.statement: The system shall provide a report template management system to manage, version, and reuse report templates.
candidates.source_quote: - No report template management system

candidates.title: Fine-grained report permissions
candidates.statement: The system shall implement fine-grained permissions controlling who can create, edit, run, schedule, and view each report.
candidates.source_quote: - No fine-grained permissions for reports
candidates.priority_signals: Conclusion: 'Implement fine-grained permissions and template management'

candidates.title: Development/training environment separation
candidates.statement: The system shall provide separate development and training environments for reporting, distinct from production.
candidates.source_quote: - No development/training environment separation

candidates.title: Configuration migration
candidates.statement: The system shall support migration of report configurations and templates between environments (development/test/production).
candidates.source_quote: - No configuration migration between environments

candidates.title: Accessibility compliance
candidates.statement: The system shall implement accessibility support for the report interface to meet applicable accessibility standards.
candidates.source_quote: - No accessibility support for report interface

candidates.title: Integrated online help
candidates.statement: The system shall include an online help system integrated with the reporting interface.
candidates.source_quote: - No online help system integrated with reports

candidates.title: Include nulls/blanks in results
candidates.statement: The system shall include null and blank fields in report results when requested or when appropriate, not implicitly filter them out.
candidates.source_quote: - All nulls and blank fields included in results - current system may filter some nulls

candidates.title: Last circulation as separate field
candidates.statement: The system shall provide the last circulation date as a separate, reportable field distinct from last edit date.
candidates.source_quote: - Ability to indicate last circulation date - not available as separate field

candidates.title: Separate checkin and renewal timestamps
candidates.statement: The system shall record and expose checkin date/time separately from renewals so reports can distinguish them.
candidates.source_quote: - Checkin Date/time not including renewals - checkin and renewal timestamps are stored together

candidates.title: Snapshot bills historical report
candidates.statement: The system shall provide a snapshot bills report that can show bill states going back in time (historical snapshots).
candidates.source_quote: - Snapshot bills report going back in time - does not exist

candidates.title: Open template reporting interface
candidates.statement: The system shall provide an Open Template reporting interface for ad-hoc reporting by advanced users.
candidates.source_quote: - Open Template Reporting - does not exist

candidates.title: Three reporting interfaces
candidates.statement: The system shall provide three reporting interfaces: canned reports, on-demand reports, and open-template reporting.
candidates.source_quote: - Three interfaces (canned, on-demand, open template) - only basic canned exists

candidates.title: Real-time reporting
candidates.statement: The system shall support real-time reporting capabilities to provide up-to-date data on demand.
candidates.source_quote: - Real time reporting - does not exist

candidates.title: Historical reporting warehouse
candidates.statement: The system shall provide a historical reporting warehouse (data warehouse) for trend and historical analyses.
candidates.source_quote: - No historical reporting warehouse

candidates.title: Last edit date excluding last circulation
candidates.statement: The system shall provide last edit date separate from last circulation so reports can show both independently.
candidates.source_quote: - Last edit date not including last circulation - does not exist

candidates.title: Last Copy Report (enhanced)
candidates.statement: The system shall provide a Last Copy Report with enhancements to fully satisfy collection management needs.
candidates.source_quote: - Last Copy Report (partially available, needs enhancement)

candidates.title: Weeding report with last circulation
candidates.statement: The system shall provide a weeding report that includes date of last circulation for each item.
candidates.source_quote: - Weeding report with date of last circulation (partially available)

candidates.title: Circulation count by circ modifier
candidates.statement: The system shall provide a Circulation Count report broken down by circulation modifier.
candidates.source_quote: - Circulation Count by Circ Modifier (partially available)

candidates.title: Circulation count by Dewey
candidates.statement: The system shall provide a Circulation Count report broken down by Dewey classification.
candidates.source_quote: - Circulation Count by Dewey (not available)

candidates.title: Circulation count by MARC fields
candidates.statement: The system shall provide Circulation Count reports aggregated by MARC field values.
candidates.source_quote: - Circulation Count by MARC fields (not available)

candidates.title: Circulation count by circ location and patron county
candidates.statement: The system shall provide Circulation Count reports by circulation location broken down by patron county.
candidates.source_quote: - Circulation Count by Circ Location broken down by Patron County (not available)

candidates.title: Circulation count by age demographic
candidates.statement: The system shall provide Circulation Count reports broken down by patron age demographic.
candidates.source_quote: - Circulation Count by Age Demographic (not available)

candidates.title: Items edited count
candidates.statement: The system shall provide a report that counts items edited within a specified period.
candidates.source_quote: - Items Edited Count (not available)

candidates.title: List items by fines stopped reason
candidates.statement: The system shall provide a report listing items grouped by the reason fines were stopped.
candidates.source_quote: - List of Items by Fines Stopped Reason (not available)

candidates.title: Overdue items with patron contact
candidates.statement: The system shall provide a report of items more than X days overdue including patron contact information.
candidates.source_quote: - Items more than XX days overdue with patron contact info (not available)

candidates.title: List items by total use count
candidates.statement: The system shall provide a report listing items that match a specific total use count.
candidates.source_quote: - List of Items with specific Total Use Count (not available)

candidates.title: List items by creation date range
candidates.statement: The system shall provide a report listing items created within a specified creation date range.
candidates.source_quote: - List of Items by Creation Date Range (not available)

candidates.title: Claims returned report
candidates.statement: The system shall provide a Claims Returned report listing items claimed returned.
candidates.source_quote: - Claims Returned report (not available)

candidates.title: Age of collection by call number
candidates.statement: The system shall provide a report showing the age of collection aggregated by call number ranges.
candidates.source_quote: - Age of collection by call number (not available)

candidates.title: Price value of collection by call number
candidates.statement: The system shall provide the price/value of the collection aggregated by call number ranges.
candidates.source_quote: - Price value of collection by call number (not available)

candidates.title: Bib records edited count
candidates.statement: The system shall provide a count of bibliographic records edited within a specified period.
candidates.source_quote: - Bib Records Edited Count (not available)

candidates.title: Bib records added by user by library
candidates.statement: The system shall provide a report counting bibliographic records added by each user by library.
candidates.source_quote: - Bib Records Added by user by library Count (not available)

candidates.title: Bib records missing specific MARC fields
candidates.statement: The system shall provide a report listing bibliographic records missing specified MARC fields.
candidates.source_quote: - Bib Records missing specific MARC fields (not available)

candidates.title: Patron count by age demographic
candidates.statement: The system shall provide a Patron Count report broken down by age demographic.
candidates.source_quote: - Patron Count by Age Demographic (not available)

candidates.title: Patron count by county
candidates.statement: The system shall provide a Patron Count report broken down by county.
candidates.source_quote: - Patron Count by County (not available)

candidates.title: Patron count by county city zip
candidates.statement: The system shall provide a Patron Count report broken down by county, city, and zip code.
candidates.source_quote: - Patron Count by County, City, & Zip Code (not available)

candidates.title: Voter survey responses report
candidates.statement: The system shall provide a report to collect and present voter survey responses.
candidates.source_quote: - Voter Survey Responses (not available)

candidates.title: List of inactive patrons
candidates.statement: The system shall provide a report listing patrons with inactive status.
candidates.source_quote: - List of Patrons with inactive status (not available)

candidates.title: Staff accounts last password change
candidates.statement: The system shall provide a report listing staff accounts with the date of last password change.
candidates.source_quote: - Staff Accounts with date of last password change (not available)

candidates.title: Holds purchase alert
candidates.statement: The system shall provide a Holds Purchase Alert report to flag holds that may trigger purchases.
candidates.source_quote: - Holds Purchase Alert (not available)

candidates.title: Unfilled holds report
candidates.statement: The system shall provide a report of unfilled holds.
candidates.source_quote: - Unfilled Holds (not available)

candidates.title: Stale holds report
candidates.statement: The system shall provide a report of stale holds (holds that have not progressed).
candidates.source_quote: - Stale Holds (not available)

candidates.title: Aged debt detailed report
candidates.statement: The system shall provide an enhanced Aged Debt detailed report with additional required fields.
candidates.source_quote: - Aged Debt detailed report (partially available, needs enhancement)
